submitted.rationale: XRD at Mn 0.19, 0.51 and 0.83 showed the same single phase (peaks at Q≈2.765 and 4.63), so XRD could not tell the compositions apart. Photocurrent peaked near the equimolar composition: Mn0.51Y0.49 gave 5.8e-7 A. Mn-rich (0.82) gave 4e-8 A and Y-rich (0.36 Mn) gave 1e-8 A, so the optimum is sharply near 1:1 Mn:Y (YMnO3-like stoichiometry).

rejected.reason: Mn-rich (0.82 Mn): photocurrent 4e-8 A, about 14x lower than index 15
Y-rich (0.36 Mn): photocurrent 1e-8 A, lowest measured
Same diffraction pattern across the whole composition line, so XRD gave no way to tell candidates apart
